actions.action: Slide plant out of pot and check roots
Trim any rotted roots with clean scissors
Check pot has drainage holes and isn't sitting in water
Repot into fresh chunky mix (potting soil with perlite and bark)
Use a pot only slightly bigger than the root ball
Check soil moisture 2 inches down with finger or skewer before watering
Water thoroughly at the soil and let drain fully
Remove badly damaged leaves with clean shears
Run a fan on low to improve airflow
Inspect under leaves and stems for mites, thrips, or scale
Post photos of roots and pot setup

reason: The answer centers on overly wet, dense soil causing root stress, which matches the confirmed old packed soil problem though it skips shipping stress. Its main steps (check roots, repot into chunky mix, remove bad leaves) match the fix that worked, and nothing it suggests is harmful.
